description: A channel-based audio network: any number of machines join named channels, and a member's microphone reaches every speaker tuned to the same channel, with push-to-talk floor control and runtime channel changes

models.short_description: Declares the channels a hub carries, and routes audio between the members tuned to each one
The hub endpoint members talk into; takes the channel floor and fans audio out to its listeners
The hub endpoint members listen to; streams whatever is being said on the caller's channel
A member's microphone and speaker joined to a channel, retunable at runtime without a config change
A switch that drives a radio, either as push-to-talk or as a channel selector
